facts: Construction began in 1938 and finished in May 1939 for the second Kaohsiung City Hall. The building survived as the city museum.

record: National Museum of Taiwan History, 1940 color postcard
facts: The four-storey central pavilion anchors side pavilions across a pale civic front. The archive describes the walls as white and the roof as pale green.

record: National Museum of Taiwan History, 1939 city hall postcard
facts: The monochrome view from the Love River shows the center, two flanking towers and two-storey ranges as built to designs overseen by Ono Yonejiro.
